assumptions: Uniform material density and 100% infill are used for digital center-of-mass intent.
A hard, level, clear desktop supplies the rolling surface.
PLA or PETG with a 0.4 mm nozzle is the intended first manufacturing process.

components.form: Ten-station smooth elliptical loft with a 27 degree section-axis sweep, laterally wandering centerline, shallow rounded star, and domed face marks.
components.interfaces: One-finger shoulder input and direct desk contact only; no assembly or mating interface.
components.name: Skew-keel body with smiling-star crown
components.placement: Printed and used with its only broad filleted landing ellipse on XY at Z=0 and the star toward +Z.
components.purpose: Provides the complete roll/yaw/pitch response, landing sole, tactile shell, and upward reveal as one printed solid.

concept.intended_interaction: Flick or roll either long shoulder on a clear, level desk; watch the pebble precess around its landing point; after energy decays, flick again from the star-up sole.
concept.signature_decision: Make the solid body itself the mechanism by sweeping section axes from a +10 degree lower rail to a -17 degree crown instead of adding a weight, axle, cavity, or loose part.
concept.summary: A one-piece skew-keel rattleback: rotated elliptical sections and a wandering centerline are designed to couple roll, pitch, and yaw into a comet-like looping wobble, then a filleted 34.4 x 20.4 mm effective landing ellipse establishes the smiling-star-up rest.
concept.title: Comet Pebble
unresolved_risks: CAD and ideal mass properties do not prove loop count, direction reversal, noise, durability, or repeatable settling on a physical desk.
Infill pattern, layer texture, material, desk friction, and launch impulse can change the rattleback response.
The object has not received a toy-standard small-parts, impact, or age-grade evaluation.

research.physical_evidence_boundary: No print, physical motion trial, durability cycle, or human playtest was performed. The looping wobble and star-up return remain designed behavior pending exact-print trials.
research.repair_record: An initial debossed smile left tangential skins and an unrounded bed cut left three isolated thin-edge samples. Rounded fused face beads and a 0.8 mm sole-perimeter fillet removed both failures; the rebuilt exact STL reported zero sub-0.8 mm surface samples across 147544 samples.
research.selected_inventor_method: Pico Press compared skew-keel rattleback, eccentric roly-poly, and offset rolling-ring families in work/make/r0001/pico_press_brief.md. The skew-keel won because the one solid supplies both spectacle and reset while preserving the no-support/no-hardware constraints.
research.verification: The final CAD runner passed layout, STEP generation, strict bed fit, exact local spec and balance audits, B-rep refs/validate/interfere, GLB/STL export, watertight manifold mesh checks, and the 0.8 mm wall gate at a 0.4 mm nozzle. Evidence is under artifacts/make/r0001/product/cad/measure/.
